description: Semantic Ground Truth — solution-root build across infra, app and agent bundles: Lakebase-backed RBAC, asset import from UC metric views + Git folders + glossary markdown, Lakebase CDF to a variant bronze table (SDP), metric views over bronze, and the Ground Truth Operations Genie agent. Bundle-only, git-editor build; no masking. The app bundle's own manifest (ground-truth-app/docs/plans/waves.json) is left untouched.

ignore_patterns: App did not respect SIGTERM timeout

sessions.title: Agent verification job
sessions.scope: agent_verification.ipynb and its job YAML in the agent bundle. No metric view deployment in this bundle.
